title: Core Awakening
js: const game = new GF.Game({id:'core-awakening',title:'Core Awakening',width:960,height:540,palette:['#00B2D2','#C0C0C0','#FFAA00','#FF5000'],background:'#0b0e1a'});let player={x:480,y:270,width:40,height:40,health:3};let enemies=[];let score=0;let enemySpawnTime=1.5;let enemyTimer=0;let enemySpeed=100;game.add('play',{init(){score=0;player.health=3;enemies=[];enemyTimer=0;},update(dt){enemyTimer+=dt;while(enemyTimer>enemySpawnTime){enemies.push({x:rand(0,960),y:0,width:40,height:40});enemyTimer-=enemySpawnTime;enemySpawnTime=Math.max(0.5,enemySpawnTime*0.95);score+=1;game.addScore(1);GF.Sfx.beep({freq:440,dur:0.1});}for(let e of enemies){e.y+=enemySpeed*dt;if(e.y>540){enemies.splice(enemies.indexOf(e),1);}}if(game.input.keys['ArrowLeft'])player.x-=200*dt;if(game.input.keys['ArrowRight'])player.x+=200*dt;if(game.input.keys['Space']){for(let e of enemies){if(e.x<player.x+player.width&&e.x+e.width>player.x&&e.y<player.y+player.height&&e.y+e.height>player.y){game.hitStop(0.1);game.shake(5,0.2);score+=5;game.addScore(5);enemies.splice(enemies.indexOf(e),1);game.burst(e.x+20,e.y+20,{count:10,speed:100,size:5,life:0.5,colors:['#FFAA00','#FF5000']});}}}if(player.health<=0)game.gameOver({message:'GAME OVER'});},draw(ctx){ctx.fillStyle='#00B2D2';ctx.fillRect(0,0,960,540);ctx.fillStyle='#C0C0C0';ctx.fillRect(player.x,player.y,player.width,player.height);for(let e of enemies){ctx.fillStyle='#FF5000';ctx.fillRect(e.x,e.y,e.width,e.height);}GF.Draw.text(ctx,'SCORE: '+score,480,30,{size:24,color:'#FFFFFF'});if(player.health<3){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,0,0,0.5)';ctx.fillRect(10,10,player.health*10,20);}}});game.titleScreen({subtitle:'Press any key to start',onStart(){game.go('play');}});
